overview.headline: Overview
overview.description: Leveraging a mix of aerial imaging, UAV photogrammetry, LiDAR, GNSS, and conventional surveying, engineers can make data-driven decisions that ensure safety, efficiency, and sustainability throughout the lifecycle of a highway project.

items.title: Preliminary Route Analysis
items.description: Remote sensing and aerial imagery used to identify optimal highway corridors, avoid sensitive terrain, and assess land use.

items.title: Topographic Mapping
items.description: Drone-based LiDAR and photogrammetry capture high-resolution elevation models for design-grade mapping and cut-fill analysis.

items.title: Ground Control Surveys
items.description: Establishment of ground control points (GCPs) using GNSS RTK for geo-referencing aerial data and validating spatial accuracy.

items.title: Alignment & Corridor Surveys
items.description: Detailed corridor surveying using total stations, GNSS, and mobile mapping systems to define centerlines, ROW, and cross-sections.

items.title: Safety
items.description: Accurate surveys contribute to road safety by ensuring proper alignment, clear sight distances, and appropriate signage.

items.title: Construction Monitoring
items.description: Integrated UAV flyovers and terrestrial control check progress, ensure compliance, and detect deviations in real time.

items.title: As-Built & Digital Twins
items.description: Post-construction 3D mapping using UAV and scanning tech feeds into BIM and digital twin environments for lifecycle asset management.

items.title: Planning & Design
items.description: Surveys provide essential data for designing new roads, considering factors like traffic volume, safety, and environmental impact.

items.title: Maintenance
items.description: Surveys help identify areas in need of repair, prioritize maintenance, and evaluate the effectiveness of repairs.

items.title: Utility Protection
items.description: Identifying and mapping utilities helps avoid damaging them during construction, minimizing disruptions.

items.title: Construction
items.description: Construction layout surveys ensure roads are built according to design plans and safety standards.

items.title: Safety
items.description: Accurate surveys contribute to road safety by ensuring proper alignment, clear sight distances, and appropriate signage.

items.title: Assets Management
items.description: Inventory surveys provide data for managing and maintaining highway infrastructure.

highwaySurveyDeliverables.headline: Highway Surveys Deliverables
highwaySurveyDeliverables.description: We deliver comprehensive data packages tailored for highway engineering and construction workflows.

items.title: As-Built Maps
items.description: As-constructed corridor maps verifying completed works against the approved design.

items.title: Digital Elevation Models (DSM, DTM)
items.description: Terrain and surface models for grading, drainage design, and earthworks balances along the route.

items.title: Setting Out Coordinates
items.description: Centerline, curve, and structure positions ready for stakeout and machine control.

items.title: 3D Spatial Data (X, Y, Z)
items.description: Corridor-wide positional data for design verification and digital twin workflows.

items.title: Contour Maps
items.description: Contours at design intervals supporting grading, cut-fill, and drainage analysis.

items.title: Comprehensive Master Plans
items.description: Consolidated route plans aligning alignment, ROW, utilities, and access points.

items.title: Building Layouts & BIM Integration
items.description: BIM-ready geometry and layouts for interchanges, structures, and roadside assets.

items.title: CAD and GIS-Compatible Shapefiles
items.description: Data packages that plug straight into CAD and GIS design environments.

items.title: Professional PDF Map Exports
items.description: Print-ready plan and profile exports for tenders, approvals, and site teams.
